0.what: Nothing: not a security or privacy event, or one with no effect on users
examples: a theoretical attack on no named product

1.what: Worth knowing: a real flaw or exposure, limited in reach or already closed, no action needed now
examples: a fixed bug that leaked a setting
a vulnerability that needs unusual conditions

2.what: Act now: users should update, uninstall or rotate credentials, or data of many users was exposed
examples: a backdoored release of a popular extension
a breach that exposed customer data
a tool that sends account details to every site it visits
